name: Inspire Fury
body:
School enchantment; Level bard 4, cleric 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a drop of bear’s blood)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target One willing creature per three caster levels, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration Concentration + 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

You fill the affected creatures with boiling fury.

While in this furious state, the creatures gain a +4 morale bonus to Strength, DR 2/magic, and fire resistance 5. While under this spell’s effect, a creature cannot cast spells or use spell-like abilities.

If an affected creature is knocked unconscious, does not attack a hostile creature, or does not take damage for 1 round, the spell ends for that creature.

This spell doesn’t stack with the barbarian’s rage ability.
